selection_rules.split: Windows of 2-4 ADJACENT first-parent commits, all non-merge and authored by 'Anh D Tran'; no lockfile/generated-only commit; no binary files; no renames/copies; squashed diff (git diff <base> <tip>) <= 30,000 chars and touching >= 2 files; every squashed hunk attributed (git blame / blame --reverse over base..tip) to exactly one commit; per-commit added/removed line counts conserved in the squash. Greedy non-overlapping scan, then seeded round-robin sampling across repos.
selection_rules.commit: Single non-merge commits by 'Anh D Tran', not lockfile/generated-only, no binary files, diff <= 30,000 chars, not used in any split case. Seeded round-robin sampling across repos.
selection_rules.auto: Single-file commits not used above: 3 with diff < 500 chars (review skipped) and 2 with 500-3000 chars (review runs).

feat(api): add public GET heatmap-card endpoint with redis PNG cache

New unauthenticated GET /v1/sessions/:id/heatmap-card renders the same
card as the existing POST, suitable as a literal og:image URL. Serves
only privacy='full' sessions (404 otherwise, no existence leak); rate-
limited 120/hr per IP; Cache-Control: public, max-age=600.

Both POST and GET now share a Redis PNG cache (heatmapCardCacheKey,
10-min TTL) keyed by session + render options so repeated requests skip
the sharp rasterization. Cache is fail-open; privacy is re-checked
against Postgres before any cached image is served.

add speculative executor with soft threshold state machine

DRAFTING -> SPECULATING -> ESCALATED or DRAFT_ACCEPTED. Fires
heavyweight in parallel when token entropy exceeds 0.8*T, cancels
if drafter recovers. Graceful fallback if heavyweight fails to start.
8 test cases covering all transitions, errors, and context cancellation.

web: fix phone-width layout

Panels are grid items and inherited min-width: auto, so the benchmark
table forced the whole grid row to 508 px on a 390 px screen and clipped
the neighbouring panels. Panels now carry min-w-0 so the overflow-x-auto
wrappers scroll inside the panel instead of widening the page.

Numeric cells in the benchmark and replay tables had no horizontal
padding, so at the table's minimum width adjacent values ran together.
Right-aligned cells now have pl-3; the first column keeps its own
class string so it does not pick up the padding.

Fact lists stack key over value below the sm breakpoint. The entropy
bars show avg/peak under the bar on phones instead of over the markers.
The architecture SVG keeps a 30 rem minimum width and scrolls rather
than shrinking its labels below legibility.

Checked at 360, 390, 768 and 1024 px: no element extends past the
viewport at any width.
